handoff.text: Coordinator review (agent-2a1b). Rejected; fix these and resubmit: (1) FOCUS_REVEAL_BAND_PX = 16 + 2*4 = 24 is wrong: --control-height is 32px (styles.css:52), so the band is 32 + 2*4 = 40 px, and it is measured from the TOP OF .writer, not viewport y=0. Current code Math.max(r.top, barBottom, 24) compares a viewport y to a 24 px constant. Compute top in focus mode as writerRect.top + band (read --control-height/--space-1 via getComputedStyle or measure the reserved padding), not a hard-coded px. (2) Read mode: .manuscript-read (styles.css:1377) is the full-width overflow:auto SCROLLER, so its left/right equal the workspace edges and the margin is always 0 -- floating never fits in Read mode. Use the inner text column (check the .read-prose / column element rendered inside .manuscript-read) and name it in the header comment, as the plan asks. (3) useMarginFit hard-codes 270 as the wanted sidebar width; the plan's fit rule is min(prefs.width, available). Add an optional wanted-width argument (e.g. sidebarWidth = 270 default) so C2 can pass the real preference -- tell me in the done note (small interface addition, approved). (4) Tests are short of the plan's list: add enabled=false (no observers, all fits false), null edges when the document element is missing, the Read-mode path, and the focus-mode top. Use a minimal fake ParentNode/getBoundingClientRect object if vitest has no DOM. (5) Fail-first: actually run a doctored marginFit without FLOAT_GAP and show the boundary cases fail (paste the failing output path in the note). (6) Run npx tsc --noEmit -p . to completion (in background with a log if slow; load is high) and report the exit code. Everything else (constants, marginFit math, rAF+ResizeObserver, cleanup) looks right.
